sources.reviewed_by: W26 six-shard Policy-v1 adjudication plus coordinator structural/privacy QA
W27 six-shard Policy-v1 adjudication plus coordinator positive-row, policy-gap, leakage, and structural QA

notes: W20 acceptance data is never admissible for W25 development or selection.
W21 is admitted only under the W25-owned frozen family split: 220 train, 100 development, 180 test.
W21 slur placeholder families test evasion mechanics, not comprehensive production slur lexicon robustness.
W26 contributes 3,561 human-adjudicated real-chat development records through a hash-pinned private source; raw production-derived text must never be committed to the public repository.
W26 connected records that share context-message IDs or exact normalized target text before freezing 3,098 family groups; split counts are 2,489 train / 506 development / 566 test.
One W26 policy-gap record ('should we rep bomb him?') is quarantined and excluded from admission pending an owner policy decision.
W27 is validation-only and contributes 3,598 independently adjudicated later-period records: 600 context and 2,998 time-based real-chat. Its role is deliberately excluded from TRAINING_ROLES.
Two W27 real-animal/pet harm records remain quarantined because Policy-v1 does not settle that edge.
W27 context and time-based partitions are family-disjoint; W20 remains untouched.
Admissions and all required W25 classifier comparison suites are frozen and ready for a private-host bakeoff.
